children.text: 查看你的战役日志。

开场 1：你坐在铁杉岛北岸阿克望的彼得斯家小厨房里。冰冷的大西洋海水拍打着屋下的木桩，海伦·彼得斯把冒着热气的马克杯放到桌上。“北岸的岩穴是个死亡陷阱，”她斩钉截铁地说。“我看你根本不知道自己将要面对什么。”

你告诉她，你很明白其中的危险。据当地传言，最近有些人失踪了。最近一起失踪的是海伦的妹妹，于是你登门拜访彼得斯家，表示愿意帮忙。

海伦上下打量你，像是在掂量你，最后点了点头。“那好吧。你要么是勇敢，要么是愚蠢。要么两者都是，跟我弟弟一样。”她烦躁地揉着额头。“我最后一次见到丽姿——伊丽莎白——是带着我们的狗布鲁斯沿海岸线散步。我跟她说过别靠近那些洞穴，可她从来不听。在里面很容易迷路，而且那里有些东西会缠着你的噩梦不放。”她把一只手电筒放到桌上。“不过，我们就从那儿开始。”
如果当前是 第一夜 或 第二夜，跳到 开场 5。否则：
如果当前是 第一日，前往 开场 2。
如果当前是 第二日，跳到 开场 3。
如果当前是 第三日，跳到 开场 4。

开场 2：你跟着海伦走到屋外，踏上阿克望村里吱呀作响的木栈道。阿克望依偎在岛屿北岸一处多岩的小海湾里，世代以来一直是阿贝纳基人家庭和老捕鲸人的家。海水在石岸边不断起伏、拍碎，给眼前的景象添上一股诡异的静默不安。海伦从一间捕鲸人的棚屋里抓起一把鱼叉，领你走向海滩。

一辆眼熟的旧皮卡在附近缓缓停下。希奥下了车，咧嘴笑着向你打招呼。“我回来了！我回了一趟山谷拿点东西，”他挥着手说。看到海伦，他的笑容消失了。

“你居然来了，真让我意外，”海伦冷冷地说。

希奥一脸沮丧。“我当然来了，姐。我怎么能不来？”

他姐姐什么也没说，从你们两个身边大步走向阴郁的海岸线。一卷浪花拍上栈道，打断了这一刻似乎正在上演的戏剧。你问希奥，他姐姐为什么反应这么冷淡，他有一瞬间显得神游天外。

“你知道，有时候人就是会渐渐疏远。就像两根树枝。它们永远连在一起，但它们——”这番越拖越长的比喻被海伦打断，她喊你到一座海边洞穴的洞口。

前往 设置。

开场 3：你和海伦正准备出发时，雨声打破了寂静。希奥从前门走进来，把湿漉漉的头发从脸上拨开。他与海伦目光相接。“所以她还是没回来，”他沉声说。希奥身上的雨水滴在饱经风吹雨打的地板上，海伦怒视着他。“你居然来了，小弟，真让我意外。迟来总比不来好，我猜。去拿绳子。”她把鱼叉甩上肩头，走进倾盆大雨里。你问希奥出了什么事，他手忙脚乱地去拿绳子和另一只手电筒。

“我们妹妹失踪了。我跟海伦说她会回来的，可现在都过去两天了。事情，呃，就是这样。”

前往 设置。

开场 4：你跟着海伦走到屋外，踏上阿克望村里吱呀作响的木栈道。阿克望依偎在岛屿北岸一处多岩的小海湾里，世代以来一直是阿贝纳基人家庭和老捕鲸人的家。“铁杉岛已经不安全了。我本以为这里能成为我们的家，可我想这不过是路上的又一个落脚点，”海伦怅然地说。村里几乎空无一人，只有一个穿海军蓝外套的老水手。你走近时，他差点让钓竿脱手。

“基甸！又在钓鱼？”海伦带着一丝苦笑说。

老水手把渔获从水里拉上来。“就一条丑鳕鱼。还有这条更丑的黑线鳕。”穿在绳上的鱼鳍多得反常，还长着尖刺般的、像藤壶一样的增生物。“你呢，海伦？”基甸问。

海伦把妹妹失踪的事告诉了老水手。老水手面露担忧。“小丽姿可是个宝贝。要是你们不嫌弃，我来帮忙。”

前往 设置。

开场 5：你跟着海伦走到屋外，踏上阿克望村里吱呀作响的木栈道。夜空阴沉多云，但南方的地平线上却悬着一抹令人不安的微光：树梢之外，远处有蓝绿交织、不断变幻的冷光。那光构成熟悉的图案：一只狮爪、一朵春花、一艘长船，最后是一个模糊的人形轮廓。你低头看去，只见海伦正没入一座漆黑如墨的洞穴。

前往 设置。

黑暗地点

《消失的姐妹》遭遇组包含 3 个双面敌人。这些敌人一面是（白日 [day]），一面是（黑夜 [night]），且被视为同一个敌人。如果这些敌人位于黑暗地点，将它们翻至（黑夜 [night]）面。反之，如果这些敌人位于没有黑暗特质的地点，将它们翻至（白日 [day]）面。从一面翻到另一面是即时效果，无法被中断。双面敌人翻转时，会保留所有标记与附属。（注意，有些敌人拥有强制–效果，在其翻至某一面后触发。）

威廉站在多岩的海岸线上，望着翻滚的浪涛和远处缅因州的海岸线。“这座被毒害的岛是汉洛克之名仅存的东西了。我家族的遗产会随我一同终结，”他苦涩地说。海伦大步上前，脸色铁青。“这座岛不属于任何人；你的遗产已经死了。在你家族把它从自然手中夺走之前，它早就是荒野，而现在，荒野要把它收回去。”

威廉盯着那抹微光，嘴唇颤抖。一道虹彩般的光带扭曲了天空。“一切美好的事物都是野性而自由的，”他虔诚地引述道。“也许我该接受这一点了。”

提高威廉·汉洛克的关系等级。每位调查员获得 1 点奖励经验。

基甸俯身端详着一处由黑沙与岩石构成的层理。“这儿也不总这么古怪。铁杉岛这些年变得挺邪门。可这么一想，我琢磨着……”老人话说了一半，陷入沉思。过了一会儿，他颤巍巍地站起来。“我在这儿丢过一件老传家宝。倒也不是真丢了，是我把它埋了，忘了埋在哪儿，你要是明白我的意思。”他东拉西扯地讲了另外三件毫不相干的往事，才又绕回来。“我还没糊涂到把它埋在沙子里。不过那儿有块大黑石头，长得有点像鲸鱼。我就埋在那儿。你要是肯帮我找，我感激不尽。”

记住“基甸正在寻找一件传家宝”。（提示：如果调查员在本关卡结束时控制至少 2 个线索，你就能帮基甸找到他要找的东西！）

如果“希奥正在与海伦争吵”，且希奥·彼得斯与海伦·彼得斯位于同一地点：

希奥与海伦互相讥讽，气氛紧张到了极点。

选择希奥·彼得斯所在地点的一名调查员进行 [willpower] 检定（4）。如果检定成功，继续阅读。否则，一名调查员可以再次触发此法典条目。

否则：

你和希奥跟着海伦穿过又一条黏滑的隧道，走进一座露天剧场大小的大厅。分叉的珊瑚和巨大的甲壳类生物攀附在四周湿冷的岩石上，有那么一瞬间，一行人集体屏住呼吸，打量着这难以置信的景象。“继续走吧，”海伦粗声说。她很快就把你和希奥甩在身后，你趁这个空当向这个年轻人多打听了一些他姐姐为何如此冷淡。

“她把……把一切都怪在山谷头上。一年前，我们在阿克望连糊口都难。她还想让我跟我父亲一样去捕鱼，可是——”他似乎被话噎住了。“也不是说我帮上过什么忙。可我去山谷的时候，我觉得自己有了位置。有了归属。蕾切尔嬷嬷说——”

“闭嘴，”海伦打断了他。“丽姿在家的时候听你吹捧那个疯子，这已经够糟了。你想当她脚边的狗，随你。你想背对我们，随你。但别在我面前放这些屁话。”

希奥被姐姐戳中了一道显然是旧伤，脸颊涨得通红。

记住“希奥正在与海伦争吵”。如果希奥·彼得斯与海伦·彼得斯位于同一地点，一名调查员可以再次触发此法典条目。

“随你怎么说，可山谷里的人对我来说，比你更像家人！”希奥喊道。你插进去，试着让两人冷静下来。海伦与弟弟目光相接，显然被刺伤了，开口道。“请别这么说。永远别说这种话。你和丽姿是我仅有的家。不是这里。不是铁杉岛。更不是佛蒙特。我只想我们是一家人。”她强硬的外壳崩裂了，开始哭泣。过了一会儿，希奥看着姐姐，嘴唇颤抖，然后无言地张臂抱住了她。

在希奥·彼得斯的笔记中记录希奥与海伦和解了。提高希奥·彼得斯的关系等级。每位调查员获得 1 点奖励经验。

如果希奥与海伦和解了：

一股腐鱼与霉味的恶臭弥漫在洞穴里。希奥看着他的姐妹逃出洞穴，神情明显挣扎，随后转向你，面容坚毅。那怪物发出咕噜的咆哮，他站到你身边。“我很确定那东西吃了丽姿的狗，”他一边说一边抽出刀。“这一下是为布鲁斯！”

将希奥·彼得斯身上的 1 点伤害移动到鳖类混种敌人身上。

否则：

希奥看着他的姐妹逃出洞穴，神情明显挣扎。长满苔藓的洞穴里弥漫着霉味与腐败的气息。那怪物发出咕噜的咆哮，年轻人一步步后退。“我忘了点东西在卡车里。我马上回来！”他说着逃离了现场。

将希奥·彼得斯移出游戏。

children.text:
马奎兹博士跪下来检查一条被切断的甲壳类肢体，上面覆满了鲜黄色的真菌。“这里有些东西深层次地出了问题。无论是什么造成了这些突变，它也在影响当地的海生生物。这层甲壳不只是长满了真菌。”她把它掰开，释放出粉末状的黄色孢子。“就好像自然的基本法则已经疯了。”

查看岩穴牌堆顶的卡牌。你可以将该地点放置入场，放在最近的洞穴地点旁；也可以将它放到岩穴牌堆底部。

双面敌人

消失的姐妹遭遇组包含 3 个双面敌人。这些敌人一面是（白日 [day]），一面是（黑夜 [night]），且被视为同一个敌人。如果这些敌人位于黑暗地点，将它们翻至（黑夜 [night]）面。反之，如果这些敌人位于没有黑暗特质的地点，将它们翻至（白日 [day]）面。

从一面翻到另一面是即时效果，无法被中断。双面敌人翻转时，会保留所有标记与附属。（注意，有些敌人拥有强制–效果，在其翻至某一面后触发。）

如果未达成任何结局（每位调查员都撤退或被击败）： 你的努力已经到了极限。那些反常的真菌和凶暴的野生动物不是你能应付的。你别无选择，只能放弃搜寻。

• 每位调查员因直面海岸洞穴的恐怖而获得 1 点奖励经验。

• 跳到 结局 4。

结局 1：你与海伦、丽姿一起回到阿克望。妹妹一边回头望着那些洞穴，一边向你道谢。海伦从她手里拿过那条磨断的狗链。“布鲁斯是条好狗，”她说。海风吹拂着彼得斯家最小的妹妹深褐色的头发，掠过她圆圆的脸，海伦伸手搂住她的肩。你问她们接下来有什么打算。

“我们不能留在这儿了，”海伦说，这话更像是说给伊丽莎白而不是你听的。妹妹还没来得及反对，海伦又继续道：“还记得诺凯梅斯给我们讲的故事吗？格卢斯卡布把一个人变成树的那一个。这座岛上的一切都不对劲。它已经变成了某种致命的东西。也许是时候去波特兰看看乔治叔叔了。”

查看你的战役日志。
如果希奥·彼得斯的笔记中记录了希奥与海伦和解了，前往 结局 2。
否则，跳到 结局 3。

结局 2：希奥从卡车回来之后，问妹妹她为什么走丢了。丽姿擦去眼里的泪水，举起那条被撕断的狗链。“布鲁斯想最后散一次步。就像我们以前那样。”两个姐姐望着大海，越过翻滚的波浪和银色的云，希奥一脸沮丧。姐姐们面对着拍岸的浪花，希奥犹豫着，想着该说些什么。

“过来，希奥，”海伦招手叫他过去。三姐弟并肩站在一起，静静地望着大海。

• 每位调查员因帮助海伦救出妹妹而获得 2 点奖励经验。

• 在你的战役日志中记录彼得斯一家团聚了。

• 跳到 结局 4。

结局 3：“我很快就开始做准备，希望再过几天我们就能离开这座岛，”海伦对你说。“我建议你也早点离开。”你告诉她，勘察还远未结束，你还有更多的事要做。海伦嗤了一声。“那是你自找的，”她说，短暂的沉默之后，她又看向你。“抱歉。我不知道自己为什么会那么说，”她说。“谢谢你的帮忙。山谷里没人会来帮忙的。”她沿着黑沙海岸望向阿克望的方向。“基甸以前常在这儿钓鱼，现在不来了。山谷把他从我们身边夺走了。现在他们又把希奥夺走了。”

她又看向你。“我还有一件事想请你帮忙。拜托。照看希奥。他心眼不坏，就是脑子有点笨。确认他没事。不管他怎么想，他终究是家人。”

• 每位调查员因帮助海伦救出妹妹而获得 2 点奖励经验。

• 在你的战役日志中记录伊丽莎白·彼得斯获救。

• 前往 结局 4。

结局 4：“密斯卡托尼克勘察队，1926 年 6 月。成员：马奎兹、马斯格雷夫等人。北岸与海岸洞穴极其危险。已确认数十种此前未有记录的生物荧光真菌。生态系统极度不友善，对光极为敏感。建议进一步分析与观察。未来的考察应备妥适当装备并格外谨慎。如有可能，避开阿克望的洞穴。”

• 每位调查员获得经验，数额等于胜利区中每张卡牌的胜利 X 值。每位调查员现在可以花费战役日志中“未花费经验”下记录的经验。

• 在战役日志的“已勘察区域”部分勾选阿克望海岸。

children.text: Check your Campaign Log.

Intro 1: You are sitting in the small kitchen of the Peters family home in Akwan, on the north shore of Hemlock Isle. Cold Atlantic seawater laps at the stilts below the house as Helen Peters sets her steaming mug on the table. "The north shore caverns are a death trap," she says firmly. "I don't think you know what you're getting into."

You tell her you are well aware of the danger. According to local rumors, some folks have gone missing recently. The most recent disappearance was Helen's sister, so you paid a visit to the Peters home to offer your help.

Helen looks you over, as if sizing you up, and finally nods. "Alright then. You're either brave, or you're stupid. Or you're both, like my little brother." She rubs her brow in frustration. "I last saw Lizzie—Elizabeth—taking a walk with our dog Bruce along the coastline. I told her to stay away from those caves, but she never listens. It's easy to get lost in 'em and there are things in there that'd haunt your nightmares." She sets a flashlight on the table. "But that's where we're going to start."
If it is Night 1 or Night 2, skip to Intro 5. Otherwise:
If it is Day 1, proceed to Intro 2.
If it is Day 2, skip to Intro 3.
If it is Day 3, skip to Intro 4.

Intro 2: You follow Helen outside and onto the creaking boardwalks of Akwan village. Nestled in a small, rocky bay on the island's northern shore, Akwan has been the home of Abenaki families and former whalers for generations. The steady swell and break of seawater on the stony shore lends the scene an eerie disquiet. Helen grabs a harpoon from a whaler's shack and leads you to the beach.

A familiar old pickup truck slows to a stop nearby. Theo steps out and greets you with a broad smile. "I'm back! I had to run back to the Vale for something," he waves. His smile vanishes when he sees Helen.

"I'm surprised you came," Helen says cooly.

Theo looks crestfallen. "Of course I came, sis. How could I not?"

His sister says nothing as she strides past you both toward the bleak shoreline. A curl of waves crashes against the walk, breaking the apparent drama of the moment. You ask Theo for the reason behind his sister's chilly response, and he looks distant for a moment.

"Y'know, sometimes people just grow apart. Like two branches. They'll always be connected, but they—" The extended metaphor is interrupted by Helen, calling you to the mouth of a seaside cave.

Proceed to Setup.

Intro 3: As you and Helen make preparations to leave, the sound of rain breaks the silence. Theo steps through the front door, brushing his wet hair out of his face. He locks eyes with Helen. "So she's still not back," he says soberly. Theo drips rainwater on the weatherbeaten floor as Helen glowers at him. "I'm surprised you came, little brother. Better late than never, I guess. Get the rope." She slings a harpoon over her shoulder and walks out into the pouring rain. Theo scrambles for rope and a second flashlight as you ask him what the matter is.

"Our sister is missing. I told Helen she would come back, and now it's been two days. That's, uh. That's what the matter is."

Proceed to Setup.

Intro 4: You follow Helen outside and onto the creaking boardwalks of Akwan village. Nestled in a small, rocky bay on the island's northern shore, Akwan has been the home of Abenaki families and former whalers for generations. "Hemlock Isle isn't safe anymore. I thought this could be our home, but I guess it's just another stop on the way," Helen says wistfully. The village is all but deserted, save for an old sailor in a navy blue coat. He nearly drops his fishing rod as you approach.

"Gideon! Fishing again?" Helen says with a wry smile.

The old sailor pulls his haul out of the water. "Nae but an ugly cod. An' this e'en uglier haddock." The fish strung through the twine have too many fins and spined, barnacle-like growths. "An ye, Helen?" Gideon asks.

Helen tells the old sailor about her missing sister. The old sailor looks concerned. "Little Lizzie's quite the treasure. I'll help, if ye'll have me."

Proceed to Setup.

Intro 5: You follow Helen outside and onto the creaking boardwalks of Akwan village. The night sky is dreary and overcast, but an unsettling glimmer lingers over the southern horizon: a distant, shifting luminescence of blues and greens beyond the treetops. The light forms familiar patterns: A lion's paw, a spring blossom, a longship, and finally, a vague humanoid outline. You look down to see Helen disappearing into an inky black cave.

Proceed to Setup.

setup.text: Gather all cards from the following encounter sets: The Lost Sister, Blight, Horrors in the Rock, Mutations, and Myconids.
In addition, check the Campaign Log for the current day and gather its corresponding encounter set for The First Day, The Second Day, or The Final Day.
Check your Campaign Log for the current day and time. Put the Time Marker card into play on its corresponding (Day [day]) or (Night [night]) side.
Put the Akwan location into play. Each investigator begins play at Akwan.
Construct the "Caverns deck" as follows:
Gather each location from the The Lost Sister and Horrors in the Rock encounter sets.
Set the Fungal Cave location aside, out of play.
Remove 2 random Cave locations from the Horrors in the Rock encounter set from the game.
Shuffle each remaining location together to form the Caverns deck. Place this deck near the scenario reference card.
Put the top three cards of the Caverns deck into play, unrevealed, below and to the left and right of Akwan (see Location Adjacency on page 3).
If it is (Day [day]), gather each story asset from the Residents encounter set. This set is indicated by the following icon:
Put Helen Peters into play under the control of an investigator. She does not take up an ally slot during this scenario.
If it is Day 1 or Day 2, put Theo Peters into play under the control of an investigator.
If it is Day 2 or Day 3, put Gideon Mizrah into play under the control of an investigator.
If it is Day 3, put William Hemlock into play at Akwan.
Remove each other card from the Residents encounter set from the game.
If it is (Night [night]), gather each story asset from the Residents encounter set. This set is indicated by the following icon:
Put Helen Peters into play under the control of an investigator. She does not take up an ally slot during this scenario.
Remove each other card from the Residents encounter set from the game.
Set each of the following enemies aside, out of play: Limulus Hybrid, both copies of Crystal Parasite, and both copies of Crustacean Hybrid.

Day and Night effects function differently during The Lost Sister scenario. During this scenario, cards at a Dark location (including the location itself) only use (Night [night]) effects. Cards at all other locations (including the location itself) only use (Day [day]) effects. This rule is in effect regardless of whether this scenario is played during the (Day [day]) or (Night [night]).

• During the evening, the moonlight is as bright as the sun. Unlike in other scenarios in this campaign, the Time Marker card has no mechanical effect during The Lost Sister scenario.

The Lost Sister encounter set features 3 double-sided enemies. These enemies have a (Day [day]) side and a (Night [night]) side and are considered to be the same enemy. If these enemies are at a Dark location, flip them to their (Night [night]) side. Conversely, if these enemies are at a location without the Dark trait, flip them to their (Day [day]) side. story.text: Place on the bottom of the Caverns deck

children.text:
William stands on the rocky shoreline looking out at the rolling surf and the distant Maine coastline beyond. "This poisoned isle is all that is left of the Hemlock name. My family's legacy will end with me," he says bitterly. Helen strides forward, her face livid. "This island belongs to no one; your legacy is dead. It was wild long before your family took it from nature, and now the wild will take it back."

William's lip trembles as he stares up at the glimmer. A rainbow band of iridescent colors warps the sky. "All good things are wild and free," he quotes reverently. "Perhaps it's time I accepted that."

Increase William Hemlock's Relationship Level. Each investigator earns 1 bonus experience.

Gideon leans forward and studies a formation of black sand and rocks. "Tweren't always so strange here. Hemlock Isle's gotten quite queer over the years. But nae I think of it, I s'pose..." The old man trails off, lost in thought. After some time, he stands up shakily. "I lost summat of an old heirloom here. Well I din't lose it sumach as I buried it an' forgot where it were, if ye get." He prattles on about three other unrelated tales before circling back. "I weren't so dull I buried it in the sand. But there were a big black rock looked a mite like a whale. That's where I buried it. If ye'd help me find it, I'd be much obliged."

Remember "Gideon is searching for an heirloom." (Hint: If investigators control at least 2 clues at the end of this scenario, you can help Gideon find what he's looking for!)

If "Theo is arguing with Helen" and both Theo Peters and Helen Peters are at the same location:

Tensions run high as Theo and Helen sling barbs at each other.

Choose an investigator at Theo Peters' location to test [willpower] (4). If this test is successful, continue reading. Otherwise, an investigator may trigger this codex again.

Otherwise:

As you and Theo follow Helen through yet another slimy tunnel, you emerge into a large room the size of an ampitheater. Branching coral and massive crustaceans grip the wet, dark rock around you, and for a moment, the group collectively holds their breath, taking in the unbelievable scene. "Let's keep moving," Helen says gruffly. She quickly outpaces you and Theo, and you take the moment to ask the young man more about his sister's icy demeanor.

"She blames the Vale for...For, well, everything. A year ago, we were barely making ends meet in Akwan. She tried to get me to take up fishing, like my father, and--" he seems to choke on his words. "It's not like I was ever any help. But when I visited the Vale, I felt like I had a place. Somewhere I belonged. Mother Rachel says--"

"Shut up," Helen breaks into the conversation. "It's bad enough Lizzie heard you talking up that loon when you were home. You wanna be her lap dog, go ahead. You wanna turn your back on us, go ahead. But don't spout any of that bullshit around me."

Theo's cheeks flush as his sister prods what is clearly an old wound.

Remember "Theo is arguing with Helen." An investigator may trigger this codex again if both Theo Peters and Helen Peters are at the same location.

"Say what you will, but the Vale are more family to me than you'll ever be!" Theo shouts. You step in and try to calm the pair. Helen locks eyes with her brother, clearly wounded, and replies. "Please don't say that. Never say that. You and Lizzie are the only home I have. Not here. Not Hemlock Isle. Certainly not Vermont. I just want us to be a family." Her tough exterior breaks as she begins to weep. After a moment, Theo looks at his sister, lip trembling, then wraps his arms around her in a wordless hug.

In Theo Peters' Notes, record Theo reconciled with Helen. Increase Theo Peters' Relationship Level. Each investigator earns 1 bonus experience.

If Theo reconciled with Helen:

A rank, fetid smell of rotten fish and mildew floods the cavern. Theo watches his sisters flee the cave, clearly conflicted, before turning to you, face set. He stands by your side as the monstrous creature lets out a gurgling roar. "I'm pretty sure that thing ate Lizzie's dog," he says, drawing a knife. "This is for Bruce!"

Move 1 damage from Theo Peters to the Limulus Hybrid enemy.

Otherwise:

Theo watches his sisters flee the cave, clearly conflicted. The mossy cave smells of mildew and decay. The young man backs away as the monstrous creature lets out a gurgling roar. "I forgot something in my truck. I'll be right back!" he says as he flees the scene.

Remove Theo Peters from the game.

Dr. Marquez kneels to examine a dissevered crustacean limb overgrown with bright yellow fungus. "There is something deeply wrong here. Whatever is causing these mutations is exerting an influence on the local sea life as well. This carapace isn't just overgrown with fungus." She cracks it open, releasing powdery yellow spores. "It's as if the basic laws of nature have gone insane."

Look at the top card of the Caverns deck. You may either put that location into play adjacent to the nearest Cave location or place it on the bottom of the Caverns deck.

Double-Sided Enemies

The Lost Sister encounter set features 3 double-sided enemies. These enemies have a (Day [day]) side and a (Night [night]) side and are considered to be the same enemy. If these enemies are at a Dark location, flip them to their (Night [night]) side. Conversely, if these enemies are at a location without the Dark trait, flip them to their (Day [day]) side.

Flipping from one side to another is an immediate effect that cannot be interrupted. When a double-sided enemy flips, it keeps all tokens and attachments. (Note that some enemies have Forced– effects that activate after they flip to one side or the other.)

If no resolution was reached (each investigator resigned or was defeated): Your efforts have reached their limit. The unnatural fungus and aggressive wildlife are too much for you to handle. You have no choice but to abandon the search.

• Each investigator earns 1 bonus experience for coming face to face with the horrors of the coastal caves.

• Skip to Resolution 4.

Resolution 1: You return to Akwan with Helen and Lizzie. The younger sister thanks you as she stares back at the caves. Helen takes the frayed dog leash from her. "Bruce was a good dog," she says. The ocean wind blows the youngest Peters' dark brown hair across her round face as Helen wraps an arm around her shoulder. You ask what their plan is now.

"We can't stay here," Helen says, more to Elizabeth than to you. Before her sister can protest, Helen goes on. "Remember the story Nokemes told us? The one about Gluskab turning a man into a tree. Everything on this island is wrong. It's transformed into something deadly. Maybe it's time we pay a visit to Uncle George in Portland."

Check your Campaign Log.
If Theo reconciled with Helen is recorded in Theo Peters' Notes, proceed to Resolution 2.
Otherwise, skip to Resolution 3.

Resolution 2: After returning from his truck, Theo asks his sister why she wandered off. Lizzie brushes tears from her eyes and holds up the torn dog leash. "Bruce wanted to go for one last walk. Like we used to." Theo looks crestfallen as his two sisters look out to sea, past the rolling waves and the silver clouds. Theo hesitates, searching for what to say as his sisters face the crashing surf.

"Come here, Theo," Helen beckons him over. The three siblings stand together, looking out to the sea in silence.

• Each investigator earns 2 bonus experience for helping Helen save her sister.

• In your campaign log, record The Peters family was reunited.

• Skip to Resolution 4.

Resolution 3: "I'll start making preparations soon and hopefully we'll be off the island in a few more days," Helen tells you. "I suggest you leave soon, as well." You tell her the survey is far from over, and there's still more you have to do. Helen scoffs. "Your funeral," she says, then after a brief silence she looks at you again. "Sorry. I don't know why I said that," she says. "Thank you for your help. Nobody from the Vale would have helped." She looks down the black sanded shore toward Akwan. "Gideon used to fish here often, but not anymore. The Vale took him from us. Now they've taken Theo."

She looks back to you. "I have another favor to ask. Please. Look after Theo. He means well, even if he's a little thick in the head. Make sure he's okay. No matter what he thinks, he's still family."

• Each investigator earns 2 bonus experience for helping Helen save her sister.

• In your campaign log, record Elizabeth Peters was saved.

• Proceed to Resolution 4.

Resolution 4: "Miskatonic Survey, June 1926. Members Marquez, Musgrave, et alii. Northern shore and coastal caves extremely dangerous. Identified dozens of hitherto undocumented species of bioluminescent fungus. An exceedingly hostile ecosystem with extreme sensitivity to light. Further analysis and observation recommended. Future expeditions should come prepared with appropriate gear and extreme caution. Avoid the Akwan caves, if at all possible."

• Each investigator earns experience equal to the Victory X value of each card in the victory display. Each investigator may now spend the experience recorded under "Unspent Experience" in your Campaign Log.

• In the "Areas Surveyed" section of your Campaign Log, check off Akwan Shoreline.
